title: New design issues
body:
@LukyVj This is an issue to track the glitches introduced via the awesome new docs design of react-instantsearch. Will be easier for you to track as a single issue. Anyone can jump in and add an item, then you check them

* \[x] examples do not have an header anymore, the new header should be ported. Or at least make the examples aware of the react-instantsearch context so the user knows how to go back. We could also use iframes here, that would be OK :)
* \[x] there's no link on the Algolia timer in hero
* \[x] there's a bug on the community dropdown on small screen
* \[x] the awesome logo and animation is too slow to show, easy to miss it. I would show it right away so the experience is not too surprising if you started to read the page already
* \[x] Can you beautify the new introduction pages for guides, components, connectors and examples (don't hesitate to ping me if you have any template related question, @bobylito)
* \[x] there's no Algolia logo in header on small screen

***

* \[ ] ~when resizing the doc window in half, there's no more menu to switch between widgets/guides/etc. Also the title/logo in the header kinda disappear. Then when resizing the window to fit all the screen, the right menu is being displayed on the header.~ \[ **It's not a bug, it's a feature** ] 
* \[ ] code snippet are not highlighted in the  guide section (only css/html remaining for now) \[ @bobylito  ]
* \[x] mobile hamburger menu works once but if you resize window back and forth it will stop working
* \[x] intro page for api (connectors & widgets) doesn't expand the body even if enough item in the sidebar.
* \[x] material-ui, media and tourism examples are still broken. Seems to be a fixed header issue. Also for material-ui, it seems that some styles are missing
* \[x] a too large value inside a prop table broke the layout (see HOC/HierarchicalMenu.html)
